name: Boxed-in dead end: reverse 3 ticks, then turn left
expected: Tick 2: at (4,3) L and R are true with the front clear: no reaction (C13).

Tick 3: at (4,2) F, L and R are all true: Disable Move Forward, Clean = clean_off, Enable Move Backward -> Direction = Backward. move_forward_active becomes false and move_backward_active true (R4, C24).
Ticks 3-5: moving backward (to (4,3), (4,4), (4,5)); reverse counter 0, 1, 2. At tick 4 the front interrupt reports F = false: not acted on (C15, C19).
Tick 6: reverse has lasted 3 ticks and left is free: Disable Move Backward, Direction = Turn Left. No Clean write: clean_off continues (C9, C4).
Tick 9: turn done, front clear: Enable Move Forward -> Direction = Forward, Clean = clean_on.
function_text: EF-05 – Side-only obstacle with front clear causes no reaction
EF-10 – Boxed in (F, L, R): move backward for at least 3 ticks, continue while both sides are blocked
EF-11 – Reverse ends with a turn, left first
EF-09 – Cleaning stopped (clean_off) only while turning or reversing
EF-16 – Front interrupt during a turn or reverse is not acted on
EF-17 – Direction and Clean are sent only when their value changes; signals only on transitions
